notes: Also a plant hormone, so a salicylate pool in a host-associated system need not be bacterial in origin.
Plants make their own auxin, so detecting the trait in a genome does not make the bacterium the source of the auxin in a plant.
Also a preservative and an industrial intermediate; the anchor carries both origins because the chemistry does not distinguish them.
Also formed by gut microbial reduction of dietary cinnamates.
Produced by host kynurenine metabolism as well as by bacteria.
